description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Basic' that extends a controller in the OpenCart framework. It defines methods for rendering and saving theme settings within the OpenCart admin panel, including handling requests, permissions, and generating views.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class for managing theme settings in the OpenCart admin panel, including display and save functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Render the theme basic settings page, including loading language, setting page title, breadcrumbs, permissions check, loading existing settings, and passing data to the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handle AJAX request to save theme settings, including permission check, saving data via model, and returning JSON response.
